name: zinterp_context_logf
description: zInterp_Context::Logf forwards a format string and varargs tail to the installed interpreter log hook when one exists.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4c1b30 validates the cdecl-style ctx argument, logFn load at context offset 0x70, null-hook return, and forwarding of fmt plus the varargs tail pointer.
The native smoke verifies the null-hook no-op path and that the installed hook receives the format string and first integer vararg through the forwarded argument tail.
